items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: every second that I've known him, every year that I've known him, I've never heard anybody say anything about Walter but a perfect gentleman

ctx.x: Had he been with Fletcher too?

Yes, Yes. He was with some of everybody, and they were proud to have him, proud to think about him, because every second that I've known him, every year that I've known him, I've never heard anybody say anything about Walter but a perfect gentleman, and I think it's kind of nice, you know?
This period that you were with Claud Hopkins, was that all just one tour? You went out to West Virginia, back, and --
